name: pulse-reflect
description: claude-reflect as a Claude Code mod: a model check on each short prompt finds reusable corrections (any language); a band above the prompt saves them to CLAUDE.md on one press

model.title: Check model
model.description: The model that checks each short prompt for a rule: an alias such as haiku or sonnet, or a full model id

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Rules the check is less sure of than this (0 to 1) are dropped. Higher shows fewer, surer rules

ruleLanguage.title: Rule language
ruleLanguage.description: english: the check writes every rule in English. same as prompt: it writes the rule in the language of the prompt it came from
